Keyboard shortcuts

Anywhere

t /
Go to a file
,
Open the settings
?
Show these shortcuts
Esc
Close the outline, a dialog or the file tree shown for the moment

In the file finder

↑ ↓
Move through the files found
Enter
Open the file
Esc
Clear and leave the finder

In the file tree

↑ ↓
Move through the files
→
Open a directory, or move into it
←
Fold a directory, or move out of it

Settings

Theme
Built-in themes and CSS files in the themes directory
Mode
Auto follows the system
Full width
Let the page take the width of the window rather than a column
Wrap code
Wrap long lines of a source file rather than scroll them
HTML preview
Open HTML files rendered, with their scripts, rather than as code
HTML previews are off: gh-mini could not listen on a port for them
Language switch
Switch between a Markdown file and its translations, and show a README in the language picked last. --translations tells how translations are named
Hide ignored directories
Leave directories git ignores, such as .venv or dist, out of the tree, the listings and the file finder. Files git ignores elsewhere still show
Avatars
Show the author of a file's last commit with their picture on GitHub, which asks GitHub for it by their email
